purpose: Deterministic, model-neutral camera and physical-expression profiles layered over immutable Action-IR; never a story authority.
global_negative_constraints_zh: 人物身份、脸、服装、武器归属始终不交换
肢体结构正常且肩臂肘腕手连续可追溯
攻击路径、防守响应、唯一接触或明确闪避与受力结果在同一物理链内
不瞬移、不穿透、不无来源漂浮、不定格、不循环、不用静态图组代替动作
无字幕、文字、UI、水印、来源身份、IP名称或文字拟声
global_negative_constraints_en: Never swap identities, faces, wardrobe, weapon ownership, or left-right limb ownership
Keep anatomically connected shoulders, arms, elbows, wrists, hands, and fingers
Keep attack path, defense timing, one contact or clear evasion, force feedback, and exit state in one causal chain
No teleportation, penetration, unsupported floating, freeze, loop, or still-image montage
No captions, readable text, UI, watermark, source identity, IP name, or written sound effect

profiles.cue_zh: 后腿蹬地，肩肘腕依次传力，直线刺出；防守方后脚横移、躯干侧转让开剑线；35mm中全景同轴短跟，脚步、剑路和终态同框。
profiles.cue_en: Drive from the rear leg through hip, shoulder, elbow and wrist into one straight probe thrust; the defender moves the rear foot and turns the torso off line; use a 35mm medium-wide same-axis short track showing feet, blade path and exit positions.

profiles.cue_zh: 转髋沉肩完成一次斜劈，对方以倾斜剑身建立唯一接触并顺力滑刃卸向体外；固定35mm中全景，同轴同时看清接触点和双脚。
profiles.cue_en: Use hip rotation and a sinking shoulder for one diagonal cut; the defender establishes one angled blade contact and slides the force outside the body; locked 35mm medium-wide on one axis with contact and both pairs of feet visible.

profiles.cue_zh: 前腿蹬地并转腰带动低位横扫；防守方双脚短促离地让剑锋从鞋底下明确通过，前掌到脚跟落地承重；28mm低机位横向跟随。
profiles.cue_en: Drive a low sweep from the planted leg and waist; the defender makes one short two-foot lift so the blade clearly passes below the soles, then lands forefoot-to-heel under weight; use a 28mm low lateral track.

profiles.cue_zh: 胸前压剑关系连续，后脚抵地承力；防守方稳定剑柄后从剑下短距起肘迫使对方松压侧退；40mm中景轻微手持，双手、兵器与躯干始终可读。
profiles.cue_en: Preserve the chest-level blade bind while the rear foot bears pressure; the defender stabilizes the hilt then drives one short elbow under the bind to force release and a side retreat; 40mm medium shot with restrained handheld motion and readable hands, weapons and torsos.

profiles.cue_zh: 双方沿平行错线冲刺，只在中心一次短促兵器接触，依惯性继续穿过后背向站定；28mm全身宽景侧移，先读会合再停镜读终态。
profiles.cue_en: Both fighters sprint on parallel offset lines, make one brief weapon contact at center, continue through on existing momentum, then settle back-to-back; use a 28mm full-body wide lateral move, then stop to read the exit state.

profiles.cue_zh: 举刀者随重心下沉垂直劈落，持枪者斜举枪杆架挡并以后脚滑半步吸收冲击；35mm略低机位中全景同时显示刀路、枪杆受力和脚步。
profiles.cue_en: The saber descends vertically with the attacker's sinking center; the spear braces diagonally and the defender's rear foot slides half a step to absorb force; use a slightly low 35mm medium-wide showing blade path, shaft load and footwork.

profiles.cue_zh: 后手推送、前手导向长枪直刺；短兵器一次拨开枪尖后沿枪杆外侧进身，枪手转髋收后手；35mm侧面同轴小幅跟随，读清路径、偏转角和距离变化。
profiles.cue_en: Rear hand drives and front hand guides one spear thrust; a short weapon parries the tip once and the defender steps in along the outside while the spearman retracts and turns the hip; 35mm same-axis side track showing path, deflection angle and distance change.

profiles.cue_zh: 腰胯带动长棍肩高横扫，防守方屈膝俯身让棍梢从头顶通过，再跨步短推持棍前臂；32mm中全景固定轴侧，禁止棍长变化或穿体。
profiles.cue_en: The waist and hips drive one shoulder-height staff sweep; the defender bends the knees and ducks under the tip, then steps in for one short palm contact on the lead forearm; locked 32mm medium-wide on one axis, with no staff-length change or body penetration.

profiles.cue_zh: 右刀试探被格开后利用该接触的转身惯性衔接左刀上挑，两次接触严格先后，第二击后立即分开；35mm中全景短横移，不快切。
profiles.cue_en: After the right saber probe is parried, carry that contact's rotational momentum into one left-saber rising cut; keep the two contacts strictly sequential and separate immediately after the second; short 35mm medium-wide lateral move without rapid cuts.

profiles.cue_zh: 绳镖先拉直再绕固定柱改向，对方在看见镖头后滚身避开，镖头钉地且绳索绷紧；28mm固定宽景完整展示柱、绳路和人物关系。
profiles.cue_en: The rope dart first extends taut, wraps one fixed pillar to redirect, and is evaded only after the defender sees the head; the dart pins into the ground and the rope ends taut; locked 28mm wide showing pillar, rope path and spatial relation.

profiles.cue_zh: 后腿蹬地、转髋送肩完成直拳；对方外拍手腕形成一次真实接触，再把反掌停在胸前一掌距离，明确区分接触与威胁临界点；40mm中全景。
profiles.cue_en: Drive one straight punch from rear leg through hip and shoulder; the defender outward-parries the wrist for one real contact, then stops the counter-palm one palm-width before the chest, explicitly separating contact from threat threshold; 40mm medium-wide.

profiles.cue_zh: 支撑脚旋转与髋部共同驱动低扫，防守方在到达前提膝以胫骨外侧一次格挡，双方随后各自落稳；32mm略低中全景。
profiles.cue_en: The planted foot and hip drive one low sweep; before arrival the defender raises one knee and checks with the outside shin for a single contact, then both settle under weight; slightly low 32mm medium-wide.

profiles.cue_zh: 先踏步收紧躯干，以肩和身体重心短距撞击胸肩区域；承受者后仰并退两小步恢复平衡；45mm中景随承受者轻退，接触只有一次。
profiles.cue_en: Step in, brace the torso, and deliver one short shoulder check with body mass into the chest-shoulder area; the receiver leans back and takes two small recovery steps; 45mm medium shot retreating slightly with the receiver, one contact only.

profiles.cue_zh: 抓腕五指位置固定，防守方先屈肘减杠杆，再沿拇指方向旋腕并转身后撤脱离；50mm中近景锁定腕部关系并保留肩部转向。
profiles.cue_en: Keep the five-finger wrist grip fixed; the defender first bends the elbow to shorten the lever, then rotates toward the thumb gap while turning and stepping back to escape; 50mm medium-close preserving wrist relation and shoulder rotation.

profiles.cue_zh: 只做三拍：试探掌被后仰避开、追拳被前臂格挡、借近身位置推肩令对方退一步；35mm同轴中全景，节奏快、快、停，四肢不并发乱动。
profiles.cue_en: Use exactly three beats: a probing palm evaded by a lean, a follow-up punch stopped by one forearm contact, then a shoulder push causing one backward step; locked-axis 35mm medium-wide, rhythm fast-fast-stop, no simultaneous limb flailing.

profiles.cue_zh: 沿同排屋脊平行追逐，每次起跳先踏实瓦面、落地屈膝承重，间距只按剧情缩短；28mm侧面宽景等速平行跟拍。
profiles.cue_en: Run a parallel chase along one roof ridge; every launch begins from a visible planted tile contact and every landing bears weight through bent knees, with distance changing only as authorized; 28mm side wide parallel track.

profiles.cue_zh: 起跳后仅以一脚短压可见竹梢，竹竿弯曲储能再回弹推动一次变向，落地屈膝卸力；24mm宽景轻抬镜同时看见起点、受力竹与落点。
profiles.cue_en: After a grounded launch, one foot briefly loads a visible bamboo tip; the stalk bends, stores force, and rebounds into one direction change, followed by a weighted bent-knee landing; 24mm wide with a light tilt showing launch, loaded stalk and landing.

profiles.cue_zh: 只做三个清楚落点，每次触水产生独立小凹陷和水环，身体沿连续抛物线前进不悬停；24mm侧面全景把三个接触点留在画内。
profiles.cue_en: Use exactly three readable contacts; each foot touch makes one small depression and ring while the body follows a continuous arc without hovering; locked 24mm side wide keeping all three contacts in frame.

profiles.cue_zh: 右脚、左脚依次在墙面形成两个可见支点，第二步蹬墙后只完成一次翻越并落地转身；28mm低机位随人物上仰后回落，不让墙遮断动作路径。
profiles.cue_en: Right and left feet establish two visible wall contacts; the second push creates one flip over and a weighted landing with a turn; 28mm low camera tilts up then returns, keeping the path visible rather than hidden by the wall.

profiles.cue_zh: 只让接触点附近雨滴短促向外偏开，随后雨线恢复；积水只响应真实脚步；35mm中全景同轴，单一雨水主反馈。
profiles.cue_en: Let only nearby rain droplets push outward briefly at the contact, then restore the rain lines; puddles respond only to real footsteps; same-axis 35mm medium-wide with rain as the single primary medium feedback.

profiles.cue_zh: 只用一根明确竹干产生一次短暂遮挡，镜头横移后人物从另一侧连续出现，遮挡不得掩盖瞬移；35mm中全景。
profiles.cue_en: Use one named bamboo trunk for one brief occlusion; continue the lateral track until the person reappears continuously on the other side, never using occlusion to hide teleportation; 35mm medium-wide.

profiles.cue_zh: 双手短暂支撑桌边、蹬地横越、收膝避开器物、离手后落地屈膝承重；32mm侧向中全景完整显示支撑与落点，桌面仅一个次反馈。
profiles.cue_en: Hands briefly load the table edge, legs drive a lateral vault, knees clear the objects, hands release, and the landing bears weight; 32mm side medium-wide showing support and landing, with only one secondary table feedback.

profiles.cue_zh: 一次水平挥斩只以同路径窄雪带证明速度，不生成独立发光能量；28mm固定宽景保留雪带方向和最终距离。
profiles.cue_en: One horizontal slash produces only a narrow snow wake along the same path to prove speed, never an independent glowing projectile; locked 28mm wide preserving wake direction and final distance.

profiles.cue_zh: 在狭巷以墙面一个可见脚点获得反作用力完成一次横向越位，墙面只落少量灰；24mm纵深宽景稳定消失点，人物不穿墙。
profiles.cue_en: Use one visible wall foot contact in the alley to gain reaction force for one lateral pass; only a little dust falls from that footprint; 24mm deep wide with a stable vanishing point and no wall penetration.

profiles.cue_zh: 三名对手按前中后三层依次出手，绝不同时拥挤攻击；每人动作后留在原层级；24mm宽景沿中轴后退，人数、身份与路径可读。
profiles.cue_en: Three opponents attack sequentially from near, middle and far layers, never crowding into simultaneous attacks; each remains in the original layer after acting; 24mm axial retreating wide with readable count, identity and paths.

profiles.cue_zh: 四名对手保持间距，只由右前方一人先攻击；主角格挡后沿该人身侧形成的开口冲出，其他人仅转身追赶；24mm轻高位宽景一次右跟。
profiles.cue_en: Four opponents keep distinct spacing and only the front-right attacker enters first; after one block the protagonist exits through that opening while the others merely turn to pursue; slightly high 24mm wide with one rightward follow.

profiles.cue_zh: 持枪阵列同节奏前进一步，枪尖保持平行层次，主角只后退观察空隙；24mm对称固定宽景强调队形和距离缩短，不复制人群。
profiles.cue_en: The spear formation advances exactly one synchronized step with parallel layered tips while the protagonist only retreats and reads the gap; locked symmetric 24mm wide emphasizing formation and shrinking distance, with no crowd duplication.

profiles.cue_zh: 仅在授权时：蹬地转髋推掌，空气压缩波沿单一方向到达目标，衣襟先受压、身体后退；效果不遮挡手部。
profiles.cue_en: Only when explicitly authorized: rear-leg drive and hip rotation produce one palm push; a single-direction air compression reaches the target, cloth reacts before body retreat, and the effect never obscures the hands.

profiles.cue_zh: 仅在授权时：细窄剑气沿剑刃延长线一次前进，切开同角度雾道并在远端产生单一结果，不追踪、不增宽。
profiles.cue_en: Only when explicitly authorized: one narrow sword-energy line travels along the blade extension, opens a same-angle channel through fog, and produces one distant result; no tracking or widening.

profiles.cue_zh: 仅在授权时：武器只接触屏障不碰人体，裂纹从唯一接触点扩散，屏障凹陷后向后消散，武器受反作用弹回。
profiles.cue_en: Only when explicitly authorized: the weapon contacts the barrier but not the body; cracks spread from one contact, the barrier dents then dissipates backward, and reaction force rebounds the weapon.

profiles.cue_zh: 仅在授权时：双方效果只在各自武器表面聚集并达到稳定峰值，本镜不冲刺、不碰撞、不爆炸，作为下一镜交棒。
profiles.cue_en: Only when explicitly authorized: each effect accumulates only on its owner's weapon to a stable peak; no charge, collision, or explosion in this shot, which ends as a handoff.

profiles.cue_zh: 仅在结构化风格授权时：硬边墨线与飞白严格跟随真实动作方向，不引用具体作品、人物或导演，不切漫画格。
profiles.cue_en: Only with structured style authorization: hard ink contours and dry-brush traces follow real motion direction; do not imitate a named work, character, actor, or director, and do not split into comic panels.

profiles.cue_zh: 仅在结构化风格授权时：侧面剪影保持关节与兵器轮廓分离，以重心和接触停顿表达动作，无字幕边框。
profiles.cue_en: Only with structured style authorization: keep side silhouettes with separated joints and weapon contours; express motion through weight shift and contact pause, without captions or borders.

profiles.cue_zh: 实景材质、自然侧光、克制胶片颗粒和真实衣料重量；威亚感必须有清楚起跳与落点，环境破坏与力量相称，不模仿具体影片或导演。
profiles.cue_en: Use practical materials, natural side light, restrained film grain and real cloth weight; any wire-work feeling must have a readable launch and landing, with environment damage proportional to force and no named-film or director imitation.
